title: Quasi-coherent sections descend along affine inverse limits
statement: Let I be a directed set [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit] and let (X_i) be an inverse system of quasi-compact quasi-separated schemes [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions] with affine transition morphisms [pqf-def-affine-morphism] and limit X [lem-weil-pbc-limit-affine-transition]. Fix an index i and a quasi-coherent module F_i on X_i [pqf-def-coherent], write F_j for its pullback to each later X_j and F for its pullback to X. Then the canonical map \varinjlim_{j\geq i} \Gamma(X_j,F_j) \to \Gamma(X,F) is bijective; in particular, a section of F_i whose pullback to X is zero becomes zero after pullback to some later stage.

proof.text: Restrict to the nonempty directed upper tail of i₀. Construct the functor of pushforward structure algebras: on U, a transition is the scheme section map appLE. Obtain its algebra colimit and underlying module diagram from lem-weil-pbc-sheaf-algebras-directed-colimit. The construction uses actual sheafification and colimit objects, not an arbitrary existence witness.

Apply lem-sc-valuation-limit-affine-pushforward-colimit to this algebra diagram and its underlying module cocone. This gives the projection-formula isomorphisms at every stage and at the limit, and the colimit cocone after tensoring with F. On pure tensor sections, module linearity and the adjunction-unit equations hr and ht show that these isomorphisms intertwine the specified transitions r and legs t. Use the existing proved public theorem AlgebraicGeometry.tensorResolution_tensor_hom_ext from WeilConjectures.AlgebraicGeometry.QCohTensorResolutionRestrictionTensor to extend these equalities on pure tensors to sheaf tensor morphisms.

The affine opens form a compact-open basis on the qcqs base, and intersections of compact opens are compact. Apply lem-sc-topological-abelian-sections-filtered-colimit at the whole open. Forgetting modules to abelian sheaves preserves colimits (the proved source-library instance SheafOfModules.preservesColimitsOfShape_toSheaf), so global module sections preserve the tensor cocone.

Identify sections of each pushforward with sections on its source, using preimage_top. The naturality established on pure tensors gives a natural isomorphism from the supplied diagram M to the tensor-section diagram, using e and hM; ht and hq identify the limit leg with q. Transport the section colimit along these isomorphisms. Uniqueness of colimit cocones makes q an isomorphism. Its injectivity sends the vanishing hypothesis to equality with the zero representative in colimit M; the concrete filtered-colimit equality criterion gives a later arrow f with M.map f x = 0.
